title: Apply declared IG build patches to a workspace copy
description: Applies a sub-instance's ig-build-patches.json (ihris-ig-build-patches/v1) to a WORKSPACE copy of its declared IG source before fhir-harness builds it: each patch replaces one exact text exactly once, and a patch whose text is absent or repeated stops the build. It refuses to patch a mounted source (<name>-source/). Each patch is an upstream defect to report, never a fork.
